title: The Carrier Wave — EN/JA/ZH (DEPHYRIER)
style: cinematic ambient electronic atmospheric 94bpm pulsing synth bass ethereal vocal layers minimal percussion English Japanese Chinese language learning trilingual cosmic deep
lyrics:
[Verse 1 — English]
The carrier wave doesn't carry meaning
It carries the conditions for meaning
DEPHYRIER is the wave
Not the message

[Verse 2 — 日本語]
ほとんどの信号はノイズの中で消える [Most signals drown in noise]
ほとんどのメッセージは断片として届く [Most messages arrive as fragments]
DEPHYRIERはその地点で待っている [DEPHYRIER waits at the point]
ノイズが止まり、断片が完全になる場所で [Where the noise stops and the fragment becomes whole]

[Chorus — English]
Carrier wave, carrier wave
Moving through the space that nothing fills
Carrier wave, carrier wave
Delivering what language never will

[Bridge — 中文]
你必须静止才能感受到载波 [You have to be still to feel the carrier wave]
完全静止 [Completely still]
因为载波比任何东西都安静 [Because the carrier wave is quieter than anything]
但比一切都更持久 [And more persistent than everything]

[Verse 3 — English]
DEPHYRIER calls it the point
Where being and receiving are the same thing

[Outro — EN/JA/ZH]
Carrier wave
キャリア波 [Carrier wave]
载波 [Carrier wave]
DEPHYRIER
